technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the Receptor Java client using Spring's REST client abstractions and JSON binding to interface with Diego runtime endpoints.
Define the runtime SPI using Java interfaces to cleanly decouple stream/job deployment from underlying target platforms (Cloud Foundry, Mesos, On-Premises).
Utilize Spring Data abstraction for the stream persistent repository to enable metadata persistence and stream state recovery upon node failures.
Refactor module deployment dependencies out of stream/job definition repositories into dedicated deployment service abstractions.
Parameterize Sqoop/Import options directly into CLI/configuration option models to replace untyped generic '--args' parameters.
assumptions: Developer has existing domain knowledge of Spring XD core, Diego Receptor HTTP APIs, and Spark Streaming frameworks.
Target test environments (Diego test runtime, local/test Mesos, Spark cluster) are readily accessible for development and testing.
Documentation tasks will be authored using the repository's standard AsciiDoc/Markdown documentation system.

activities.activity_description: Develop a dedicated Java client library wrapping the Receptor HTTP API to enable interaction with Diego runtime from Spring XD.
Refactor the stream and job definition repositories to remove direct coupling with module deployment logic.
Design and implement the SPI interface and base abstractions for supporting multiple deployment targets (Cloud Foundry, Mesos, On-Prem).
Implement persistent metadata storage for streams and stream recovery logic to re-establish streaming pipelines under failure conditions.
Write reference documentation explaining how to double-escape quotes (e.g., \\N) for Sqoop job submissions.
Update streaming pipeline creation logic and modules to support the latest specifications for Spark and Spark Streaming.
Document architectural patterns, configuration, and practical examples for nesting batch jobs and workflows in Spring XD.
Refactor import CLI options to parameterize all import settings, replacing the deprecated generic --args option.
Perform end-to-end integration testing for persistent streams, pluggable SPI runtime execution, Receptor interactions, and Spark pipelines.
